title: 全量 + 增量备份链的组合复原与缺失增量对照
expected_output:
=== 全量 + 增量备份链复原 ===
线上库当前状态 = [(1, 'alice', 800), (3, 'carol', 200), (4, 'dave', 300)]
线上库校验和 = d7422915f6e84f1b53c40d1084c12cdd236a544d61cd250837c69dd14cae00f5
备份链: 全量(T0) -> 增量1(2 条操作) -> 增量2(2 条操作)
[复原·全链] 状态 = [(1, 'alice', 800), (3, 'carol', 200), (4, 'dave', 300)]
[复原·全链] 与线上库一致 = True
[复原·只到增量1] 状态 = [(1, 'alice', 800), (2, 'bob', 500), (3, 'carol', 200)]
[复原·只到增量1] 与线上库一致 = False
[复原·只到增量1] 缺失行 id = [4]
结论: 增量链必须按序补全；漏一个增量，恢复出来就是「另一个时间点」的库
code:
import sqlite3, hashlib

DDL = "CREATE TABLE accounts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, balance INT NOT NULL);"
FULL = [(1, "alice", 1000), (2, "bob", 500)]
INCR1 = [("insert", (3, "carol", 200)), ("update", (1, 800))]
INCR2 = [("insert", (4, "dave", 300)), ("delete", (2,))]


def apply_ops(con, ops):
    for op in ops:
        kind = op[0]
        if kind == "insert":
            con.execute("INSERT INTO accounts(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", op[1])
        elif kind == "update":
            con.execute("UPDATE accounts SET balance=? WHERE id=?", (op[1][1], op[1][0]))
        else:
            con.execute("DELETE FROM accounts WHERE id=?", op[1])
    con.commit()


def state(con):
    return con.execute("SELECT id,owner,balance FROM accounts ORDER BY id").fetchall()


def digest(con):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for row in con.execute("SELECT * FROM accounts ORDER BY id"):
        h.update(repr(tuple(row)).encode("utf-8"))
    return h.hexdigest()


def restore(upto_incr):
    con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    con.execute(DDL)
    con.executemany("INSERT INTO accounts(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", FULL)
    con.commit()
    chain = [INCR1, INCR2][:upto_incr]
    for ops in chain:
        apply_ops(con, ops)
    return con


print("=== 全量 + 增量备份链复原 ===")
live = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
live.execute(DDL)
live.executemany("INSERT INTO accounts(id,owner,balance) VALUES (?,?,?)", FULL)
live.commit()
apply_ops(live, INCR1)
apply_ops(live, INCR2)
print("线上库当前状态 =", state(live))
print("线上库校验和 =", digest(live))

print("备份链: 全量(T0) -> 增量1(2 条操作) -> 增量2(2 条操作)")

r2 = restore(2)
print("[复原·全链] 状态 =", state(r2))
print("[复原·全链] 与线上库一致 =", digest(r2) == digest(live))

r1 = restore(1)
print("[复原·只到增量1] 状态 =", state(r1))
print("[复原·只到增量1] 与线上库一致 =", digest(r1) == digest(live))
missing = sorted(set(r[0] for r in state(live)) - set(r[0] for r in state(r1)))
print("[复原·只到增量1] 缺失行 id =", missing)
print("结论: 增量链必须按序补全；漏一个增量，恢复出来就是「另一个时间点」的库")
